subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your upcoming flight booking from New York to London on June 15th, 2022. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number: XYZ123, Departure time: 10:00 AM, Arrival time: 3:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Best regards, Airline Customer Service
